_comment: Use-case catalogue referenced by robots[].use_case_fits and deployments[].use_case_slug. Upserted by slug.

use_cases.name: Warehouse & Logistics
use_cases.description: Humanoids for material movement in warehouses and distribution centers.

use_cases.name: Manufacturing
use_cases.description: Humanoids on production lines and intralogistics in factories.

use_cases.name: Research & Education
use_cases.description: Humanoid platforms for labs and universities.

use_cases.name: Events & Entertainment
use_cases.description: Humanoids as attractions, presenters and brand activations.

use_cases.name: Retail & Service
use_cases.description: Humanoids in shops, branches and other customer-facing service environments: assisting and informing customers, demonstrating products and supporting store operations.
use_cases.typical_requirements: Reliable speech and interaction in noisy public spaces, safe operation among untrained members of the public, long unattended duty hours, and integration with store or service systems.
use_cases.key_limitations: Most humanoids here inform and interact rather than handle goods; unattended operation in a third-party store is rarely documented, and the return on investment is often novelty-driven.

use_cases.name: Healthcare & Rehabilitation
use_cases.description: Humanoids used in rehabilitation research, therapeutic assistance, healthcare education, clinical research and healthcare service environments.
use_cases.typical_requirements: Safe physical and social interaction with patients and older people, supervision by qualified staff, hygiene and data-protection compliance, and for any medical purpose the applicable medical-device approval.
use_cases.key_limitations: Research and experimental use only: no clinical validation or regulatory approval as a medical device is recorded for any robot in this catalogue. A robot listed here is positioned for or studied in healthcare settings; it is not a validated treatment or care device.

use_cases.name: Security & Inspection
use_cases.description: Humanoids for security patrols, facility monitoring and surveillance, remote inspection and inspection of hazardous environments.
use_cases.typical_requirements: Long autonomous runtime, dependable navigation of the site, remote supervision and teleoperation, suitable sensor payloads, and environmental protection for outdoor or hazardous areas.
use_cases.key_limitations: Quadrupeds and wheeled robots currently dominate this field; documented humanoid deployments are few, and environmental ratings and inspection payloads are rarely published.
